article.hook: You notice when kindness suddenly feels like a rebellion. Uranus in Pisces shakes up how we soften the edges and reimagine mercy without limits.
article.lived: This transit spans about seven years, a stretch where imagination and empathy fuse into unexpected jolts. We find people rewiring compassion - offering help that unsettles routines, or dreaming solutions that ignore usual rules. In daily moments, that looks like showing up with wild generosity that feels unfamiliar but necessary, or spotting cracks in how we’ve always ‘been good’ to each other.
article.turn: The impulse to disrupt with tender chaos can slip into disappearing when things get too real. Escaping into daydreams or endless compassion can become a way to dodge the sharp edges of change. You don’t fix instability by floating further away - sometimes the most radical act is staying present and tracing the break instead of fleeing it.
moves: Start a conversation that refuses quick fixes and welcomes hard questions.
Share a creative idea that challenges how kindness usually shows up.
Notice when your empathy becomes a shield to avoid conflict and name it aloud.

notes: closer is long; end on a shorter line with bite
